meta.name: self-improvement
meta.description: Captures learnings, errors, and corrections to enable continuous improvement. Use when: (1) A command or operation fails unexpectedly, (2) User corrects Claude ('No, that's wrong...', 'Actually...'), (3) User requests a capability that doesn't exist, (4) An external API or tool fails, (5) Claude realizes its knowledge is outdated or incorrect, (6) A better approach is discovered for a recurring task. Also review learnings before major tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录经验教训,持续改进工作方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望每次操作后自动积累经验,避免重复犯错
copy.tagline_en: Capture learnings and errors for continuous improvement
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically accumulate experience after each operation and avoid repeating mistakes

howto.what: Claude 会自动记录错误、用户纠正、功能请求等，并写入 .learnings/ 目录下的 Markdown 文件。重要经验会提升到项目记忆文件（如 CLAUDE.md）中。
howto.when: 当命令失败、用户纠正 Claude、请求不存在功能、外部工具出错、Claude 发现知识过时或发现更好的做法时触发。

say.text: 刚才那个命令报错了，帮我记下来。
你能帮我加个导出功能吗？
say.note: 触发功能请求记录到 FEATURE_REQUESTS.md

howto.what_en: Claude automatically logs errors, corrections, feature requests, etc., to Markdown files in .learnings/. Important learnings are promoted to project memory files like CLAUDE.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a command fails, user corrects Claude, user requests a missing feature, an external tool fails, Claude realizes outdated knowledge, or a better approach is found.

say_en.text: That command just failed, please log it.
No, it should be done this way.
Can you add an export feature?
say_en.note: Triggers feature request logging to FEATURE_REQUESTS.md
